error_details.message: DC cloning prerequisite was not satisfied: source is not a member of Cloneable Domain Controllers

rejection_resource.template: The local domain controller is not a member of the 'Cloneable Domain Controllers' group. Please ensure that the local domain controller has the necessary permission to clone itself, either through membership in the 'Cloneable Domain Controllers' group or by granting the local domain controller the control access right 'Allow a DC to create a clone of itself' on the domain NC.

error_details.message: DC cloning prerequisite was not satisfied: applications remain excluded or inventory is incomplete

rejection_resource.template: Validation of the cloning allow list failed. Please run the Get-ADDCCloningExcludedApplicationList cmdlet and evaluate the listed applications for cloning impact; then either remove them from the source domain controller or add them to the CustomDCCloneAllowList.xml file.
